EC1: Patients with severe-complicated disease that would compromise oral therapy (hypotenstion [OR] or shock [OR], ileus [OR] or bowel obstruction [OR], megacolon).
EC2: Patients with an allergy to oral vancomycin  [OR]or fidaxomicin.
EC3: Patients anticipated to receive metronidazole after enrollment.
EC4: Patients who already received oral vancomycin or [OR] metronidazole (either oral or intravenous) for > 24 hours within the preceding 72 hours at the time of enrollment.
EC5: Patients anticipated to receive adjunctive C. difficile therapy (rifaxamin, ni [OR]tazoxanide, ti [OR]gecycline) after enrollment.
